boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along Grove City’s Broad Street, Main Street, and College Avenue corridors, each paired with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Coffee on Broad Street
cards.subtitle: Broad Street corridor — coffee and café drinks
cards.notes: Use this Broad Street stop for a café break; check the posted daily hours before heading downtown, especially on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown coffeehouse at 141 South Broad Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The business identifies Beans on Broad at 141 S. Broad St. and publishes hours for every day of the week.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–4 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 8 a.m.–4 p.m.; confirm before visiting.

cards.title: A Full Meal on South Broad
cards.subtitle: Broad Street corridor — sit-down dining
cards.notes: Choose this block when you want a sit-down meal, and consult the restaurant’s current menu and posted operating days first.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant destination at 131 South Broad Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Broad Street Grille’s official site places the restaurant at 131 South Broad Street and describes its food service and menu.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant lists Tuesday–Thursday 11 a.m.–9 p.m. and Friday–Saturday 11 a.m.–10 p.m.; Sunday and Monday are closed.

cards.title: Sushi on South Broad
cards.subtitle: Broad Street corridor — Japanese food
cards.notes: Head to this South Broad address for sushi or another listed menu item; use the official ordering page to plan pickup.
cards.short_summary: A Japanese restaurant stop at 138 South Broad Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Jin Sushi’s official ordering page gives its location as 138 S. Broad St., Grove City, and provides online ordering.
cards.access_notes: Consult the official ordering page for current availability before traveling; no hours are stated on the cited page.

cards.title: House-Roasted Coffee Farther Down Broad
cards.subtitle: Broad Street corridor — roastery and café
cards.notes: Continue south on Broad Street for the Grove City roastery location; arrive before its posted afternoon closing time.
cards.short_summary: A coffee roastery and café at 221 South Broad Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Collage Coffee identifies its Grove City roastery at 221 S. Broad St. and lists Monday–Saturday café hours.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Monday–Saturday 7 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday closed.

cards.title: Browse Books on South Broad
cards.subtitle: Broad Street corridor — independent bookstore
cards.notes: Make this South Broad storefront your book-browsing stop; verify opening hours directly with the shop before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A brick-and-mortar bookstore at 251 South Broad Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Atlantic Independent Booksellers Association lists Bookends at 251 South Broad Street as a street-location bookstore carrying new and used books.
cards.source_title: Bookends Bookstore & Homeschool Resource Center, LLC
cards.access_notes: The cited booksellers-association listing does not publish current operating hours; contact the store before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Grove City Area Historical Society & Museum
cards.title: Local History on College Avenue
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor — community museum
cards.notes: Visit during the museum’s seasonal public window, and leave enough time to examine its Grove City history displays.
cards.short_summary: A local-history museum housed at 111 College Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s official contact page gives its address as 111 College Ave. and publishes seasonal museum hours.
cards.source_title: Contact Us - Grove City Area Historical Society & Museum
cards.access_notes: Open mid-April through mid-December: Monday 6–8 p.m. and Tuesday–Saturday noon–3 p.m.; the site currently also displays a seasonal-closure notice.

cards.title: Library Time on West Main
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — public library
cards.notes: Use this West Main stop for books or library services; match your visit to the day-specific schedule on its homepage.
cards.short_summary: The borough’s community library at 125 West Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s official homepage identifies Grove City Community Library at 125 W. Main Street and lists its weekly hours.
cards.access_notes: The official schedule varies by day and includes reduced summer Saturday hours from June 20 through August 29; Sunday is closed.

cards.title: Outdoor Recreation on West Main
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — community park
cards.notes: Enter from West Main Street for the walking trail, playground, courts, pond, or disc-golf course; follow posted park rules.
cards.short_summary: A municipal park with multiple outdoor recreation options.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City Borough states that Memorial Park’s main entrance is on West Main Street and documents its trail, playground, courts, pond, pavilions, and disc-golf course.
cards.access_notes: General park hours are not stated on the cited page. The pool is seasonal, has separate hours, and charges admission.

cards.title: Pizza on West Main
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — pizza shop
cards.notes: Use this West Main destination for pizza or another listed menu item; check the location page for that day’s closing time.
cards.short_summary: A pizza shop at 604 West Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Joe’s official Grove City location page lists the shop at 604 W. Main St. and provides its menu and daily hours.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists 11 a.m. opening daily, 10 p.m. closing Friday–Saturday, and 9 p.m. closing other days.

cards.title: Bowling on East Main
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — bowling and arcade
cards.notes: Follow Main Street east for bowling or arcade play; call ahead for lane availability, reservations, and current pricing.
cards.short_summary: A family entertainment center at 540 East Main Street Extension.
cards.evidence_claim: Bowl-O-Drome’s official page locates the venue at 540 East Main Street Extension and documents 20 bowling lanes, arcade entertainment, and a snack bar.
cards.access_notes: Current public hours are not stated on the cited page; call the official number before visiting or reserving a lane.
